data.label: Healthcare Governed Record
data.description: A healthcare record. The governed record: the data cluster, the PROV activity and agent and the audit event from the ProvGov library by identifier, and the digital signature proof. Members: Patient Record; prov-activity (Provgov); prov-agent (Provgov); audit-event (Provgov); Digital Signature Proof.

items.label: Digital Signature Proof
items.description: Cryptographic proof of attestation (digital signature)

items.label: Audit Event
items.description: A logged access or custody event as data: what was done, by whom, on what, with what outcome and for what purpose. The audit-only case of sdc5 issue 002; state-changing operations are workflow transitions.

items.label: Audit Agent Reference
items.description: The acting agent (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.who). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Entity Reference
items.description: The entity the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.entity.what). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Event Identifier
items.description: The identifier of the audit event.

items.label: Data Subject Reference
items.description: The data subject or patient the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.patient; SDC DM.subject). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: On Behalf Of Reference
items.description: The party on whose behalf the agent acted (FHIR agent.onBehalfOf; prov:actedOnBehalfOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: System Identifier
items.description: The system that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.source.observer; SDC AuditType.system-id).

items.label: System Location Name
items.description: The site or facility that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.location; prov:atLocation).

items.label: Audit Event Action
items.description: The operation performed in a logged access event (FHIR AuditEvent.action). Read and Execute change no state and are audit facts, not workflow moves.

items.label: Audit Event Outcome
items.description: The result of an audited event (FHIR AuditEvent.outcome).

items.label: Confidentiality
items.description: The level of protection the information requires (HL7 v3 Confidentiality). At assembly the value populates a component's act tag.

items.label: Provenance Agent Type
items.description: The functional role of an agent in an activity (FHIR Provenance.agent.type).

items.label: Purpose of Use
items.description: Why the information was used (HL7 v3 ActReason purpose of use). Activity context, not an access-control tag.

items.label: Audit Recorded At
items.description: When the audit event was recorded (FHIR AuditEvent.recorded).

items.label: Patient Record
items.description: A patient's record: the national ID, the FHIR Patient (Default person demographics, medical record number, marital status, address, contact point by identifier), allergies and intolerances, conditions (SNOMED CT and ICD-10-CM coded values), medication orders (RxNorm), immunizations (CVX), encounters and the vital signs panel, all from the FHIR library by identifier. Members: National ID (CID); patient (FHIR); allergy-intolerance (FHIR); condition (FHIR); medication-order (FHIR); immunization (FHIR); encounter (FHIR); vital-signs-panel (FHIR).

items.label: National ID (CID)
items.description: Cordova National Identity Number. Format: COR-PPCC-NNNNNN where PP is the two-letter province code (AL=Aldara, BR=Brevina, CE=Celara), CC is the two-digit city code (01-03), and NNNNNN is a six-digit sequence number. Issued at birth or naturalization. Required for all government transactions.

items.label: Allergy Intolerance
items.description: An allergy or intolerance: the allergen coded in SNOMED CT, category, type, clinical and verification status, criticality, dates, note and reactions.

items.label: Allergy Note
items.description: A note about the allergy. FHIR AllergyIntolerance.note.

items.label: Allergy Category
items.description: The category of the substance. FHIR AllergyIntolerance.category; AllergyIntoleranceCategory, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Allergy Clinical Status
items.description: The clinical status. FHIR AllergyIntolerance.clinicalStatus; AllergyIntolerance Clinical Status Codes, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Allergy Criticality
items.description: The potential clinical harm of a future reaction. FHIR AllergyIntolerance.criticality; AllergyIntoleranceCriticality, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Allergy Type
items.description: Allergy or intolerance. FHIR AllergyIntolerance.type; AllergyIntoleranceType, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Allergy Verification Status
items.description: The certainty of the allergy. FHIR AllergyIntolerance.verificationStatus; AllergyIntolerance Verification Status Codes, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Allergy Onset Date
items.description: When the allergy was identified. FHIR AllergyIntolerance.onsetDateTime.

items.label: Allergy Recorded Date
items.description: When the allergy was first recorded. FHIR AllergyIntolerance.recordedDate.

items.label: Last Reaction Date
items.description: When the last reaction occurred. FHIR AllergyIntolerance.lastOccurrence.

items.label: Allergen (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The substance or product responsible. A coded value: the SNOMED CT code, its display text and the fixed code system, resolved on the code system IRI (FHIR Coding). FHIR AllergyIntolerance.code.

items.label: Code System: SNOMED CT
items.description: The code system of a coded value, fixed: SNOMED CT (http://snomed.info/sct). FHIR Coding.system.

items.label: Allergen Code (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The SNOMED CT code for the substance or product responsible. FHIR AllergyIntolerance.code, coded in http://snomed.info/sct.

items.label: Code Display Text
items.description: The human-readable display of a coded value, as recorded with the code (FHIR Coding.display).

items.label: Allergy Reaction
items.description: A reaction event: manifestation, substance and exposure route coded in SNOMED CT, description, severity and onset.

items.label: Reaction Description
items.description: A description of the reaction. FHIR AllergyIntolerance.reaction.description.

items.label: Reaction Severity
items.description: The severity of the reaction. FHIR AllergyIntolerance.reaction.severity; AllergyIntoleranceSeverity, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Reaction Onset
items.description: When the reaction began. FHIR AllergyIntolerance.reaction.onset.

items.label: Exposure Route (SNOMED CT)
items.description: How the subject was exposed to the substance. A coded value: the SNOMED CT code, its display text and the fixed code system, resolved on the code system IRI (FHIR Coding). FHIR AllergyIntolerance.reaction.exposureRoute.

items.label: Exposure Route Code (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The SNOMED CT code for how the subject was exposed to the substance. FHIR AllergyIntolerance.reaction.exposureRoute, coded in http://snomed.info/sct.

items.label: Reaction Manifestation (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The clinical symptoms or signs of the reaction. A coded value: the SNOMED CT code, its display text and the fixed code system, resolved on the code system IRI (FHIR Coding). FHIR AllergyIntolerance.reaction.manifestation.

items.label: Reaction Manifestation Code (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The SNOMED CT code for the clinical symptoms or signs of the reaction. FHIR AllergyIntolerance.reaction.manifestation, coded in http://snomed.info/sct.

items.label: Reaction Substance (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The substance that caused the reaction. A coded value: the SNOMED CT code, its display text and the fixed code system, resolved on the code system IRI (FHIR Coding). FHIR AllergyIntolerance.reaction.substance.

items.label: Reaction Substance Code (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The SNOMED CT code for the substance that caused the reaction. FHIR AllergyIntolerance.reaction.substance, coded in http://snomed.info/sct.

items.label: Condition
items.description: A clinical condition, problem or diagnosis: the diagnosis coded in SNOMED CT and ICD-10-CM, category, clinical and verification status, severity, onset and abatement.

items.label: Condition Category
items.description: Whether the condition is a problem-list item or an encounter diagnosis. FHIR Condition.category; Condition Category Codes, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Condition Clinical Status
items.description: The clinical status of the condition. FHIR Condition.clinicalStatus; Condition Clinical Status Codes, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Condition Verification Status
items.description: The verification status of the condition. FHIR Condition.verificationStatus; ConditionVerificationStatus, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Abatement Date
items.description: When the condition resolved or went into remission. FHIR Condition.abatementDateTime.

items.label: Onset Date
items.description: When the condition began. FHIR Condition.onsetDateTime.

items.label: Condition Severity (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The subjective severity of the condition. A coded value: the SNOMED CT code, its display text and the fixed code system, resolved on the code system IRI (FHIR Coding). FHIR Condition.severity.

items.label: Condition Severity Code (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The SNOMED CT code for the subjective severity of the condition. FHIR Condition.severity, coded in http://snomed.info/sct.

items.label: Diagnosis (ICD-10-CM)
items.description: The condition, problem or diagnosis. A coded value: the ICD-10-CM code, its display text and the fixed code system, resolved on the code system IRI (FHIR Coding). FHIR Condition.code.

items.label: Code System: ICD-10-CM
items.description: The code system of a coded value, fixed: ICD-10-CM (http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10-cm). FHIR Coding.system.

items.label: Diagnosis Code (ICD-10-CM)
items.description: The ICD-10-CM code for the condition, problem or diagnosis. FHIR Condition.code, coded in http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10-cm.

items.label: Diagnosis (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The condition, problem or diagnosis. A coded value: the SNOMED CT code, its display text and the fixed code system, resolved on the code system IRI (FHIR Coding). FHIR Condition.code.

items.label: Diagnosis Code (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The SNOMED CT code for the condition, problem or diagnosis. FHIR Condition.code, coded in http://snomed.info/sct.

items.label: Encounter
items.description: An interaction between a patient and healthcare providers: status, class, priority, reason, period, length and hospitalization.

items.label: Encounter Class
items.description: The setting of the encounter (HL7 v3 ActEncounterCode). FHIR Encounter.class; ActCode, version 11.0.0.

items.label: Encounter Priority
items.description: The urgency of the encounter (HL7 v3 ActPriority). FHIR Encounter.priority; ActPriority, version 5.0.0.

items.label: Encounter Status
items.description: The lifecycle state of the encounter. FHIR Encounter.status; EncounterStatus, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Encounter Length
items.description: How long the encounter lasted, in the Default time units. FHIR Encounter.length.

items.label: Encounter End
items.description: When the encounter ended. FHIR Encounter.period.end.

items.label: Encounter Start
items.description: When the encounter started. FHIR Encounter.period.start.

items.label: Encounter Reason (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The reason the encounter takes place. A coded value: the SNOMED CT code, its display text and the fixed code system, resolved on the code system IRI (FHIR Coding). FHIR Encounter.reasonCode.

items.label: Encounter Reason Code (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The SNOMED CT code for the reason the encounter takes place. FHIR Encounter.reasonCode, coded in http://snomed.info/sct.

items.label: Hospitalization
items.description: The admission and discharge facts of an inpatient encounter.

items.label: Admit Source
items.description: Where the patient was admitted from. FHIR Encounter.hospitalization.admitSource; Admit source, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Discharge Disposition
items.description: Where the patient went on discharge. FHIR Encounter.hospitalization.dischargeDisposition; Discharge disposition, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Immunization
items.description: A vaccine administration: the vaccine coded in CVX, lot and expiry, status, route, site, dose, date, source, subpotency, note, reaction and protocol.

items.label: Is Subpotent
items.description: Whether the dose is known to be subpotent. FHIR Immunization.isSubpotent.

items.label: Primary Source Indicator
items.description: Whether the record comes from the person who administered the vaccine. FHIR Immunization.primarySource.

items.label: Immunization Note
items.description: A note about the immunization. FHIR Immunization.note.

items.label: Vaccine Lot Number
items.description: The lot number of the vaccine. FHIR Immunization.lotNumber.

items.label: Immunization Status
items.description: Whether the immunization was completed, not done or entered in error. FHIR Immunization.status; EventStatus, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Injection Site
items.description: The body site of the injection (HL7 v3 ActSite). FHIR Immunization.site; ActSite, version 5.0.0.

items.label: Dose Quantity Administered
items.description: The amount of vaccine administered. FHIR Immunization.doseQuantity.

items.label: Vaccination Date
items.description: When the vaccine was administered. FHIR Immunization.occurrenceDateTime.

items.label: Vaccine Expiration Date
items.description: When the vaccine lot expires. FHIR Immunization.expirationDate.

items.label: Administration Route (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The route the vaccine was administered by. A coded value: the SNOMED CT code, its display text and the fixed code system, resolved on the code system IRI (FHIR Coding). FHIR Immunization.route.

items.label: Administration Route Code (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The SNOMED CT code for the route the vaccine was administered by. FHIR Immunization.route, coded in http://snomed.info/sct.

items.label: Immunization Reaction
items.description: A reaction following an immunization: when, and whether it was self-reported.

items.label: Immunization Reaction Reported
items.description: Whether the reaction was self-reported. FHIR Immunization.reaction.reported.

items.label: Immunization Reaction Date
items.description: When the reaction occurred. FHIR Immunization.reaction.date.

items.label: Vaccine (CVX)
items.description: The vaccine product administered. A coded value: the CVX code, its display text and the fixed code system, resolved on the code system IRI (FHIR Coding). FHIR Immunization.vaccineCode.

items.label: Code System: CVX
items.description: The code system of a coded value, fixed: CVX (http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/cvx). FHIR Coding.system.

items.label: Vaccine Code (CVX)
items.description: The CVX code for the vaccine product administered. FHIR Immunization.vaccineCode, coded in http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/cvx.

items.label: Vaccine Protocol
items.description: The protocol the immunization was given under: series, target disease and dose position.

items.label: Protocol Series Name
items.description: The name of the vaccine series. FHIR Immunization.protocolApplied.series.

items.label: Dose Number in Series
items.description: The position of this dose in the series. FHIR Immunization.protocolApplied.doseNumberPositiveInt.

items.label: Doses in Series
items.description: The recommended number of doses in the series. FHIR Immunization.protocolApplied.seriesDosesPositiveInt.

items.label: Target Disease (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The disease the vaccine protects against. A coded value: the SNOMED CT code, its display text and the fixed code system, resolved on the code system IRI (FHIR Coding). FHIR Immunization.protocolApplied.targetDisease.

items.label: Target Disease Code (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The SNOMED CT code for the disease the vaccine protects against. FHIR Immunization.protocolApplied.targetDisease, coded in http://snomed.info/sct.

items.label: Medication Order
items.description: An order for a medication: the drug coded in RxNorm, status, intent, dose, frequency, route, date, prescriber and dispense request.

items.label: Prescriber Reference
items.description: Who ordered the medication. Holds the IRI of the referenced resource. FHIR MedicationRequest.requester.

items.label: Dose Frequency
items.description: How often the dose is taken (HL7 v3 timing abbreviations). FHIR MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction.timing; GTSAbbreviation, version 5.0.0.

items.label: Medication Request Intent
items.description: Whether the request is a proposal, plan or order. FHIR MedicationRequest.intent; Medication request intent, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Medication Request Status
items.description: The state of the order. FHIR MedicationRequest.status; Medicationrequest status, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Dose Quantity
items.description: The amount of medication per dose. FHIR MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction.doseAndRate.doseQuantity.

items.label: Prescription Date
items.description: When the order was written. FHIR MedicationRequest.authoredOn.

items.label: Dispense Request
items.description: What may be dispensed: substitution, refills and quantity.

items.label: Substitution Allowed
items.description: Whether substitution is allowed. FHIR MedicationRequest.substitution.allowedBoolean.

items.label: Dispense Quantity
items.description: The number of units to dispense. FHIR MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.quantity.

items.label: Number of Refills
items.description: The number of refills allowed. FHIR MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.numberOfRepeatsAllowed.

items.label: Medication Route (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The route of administration. A coded value: the SNOMED CT code, its display text and the fixed code system, resolved on the code system IRI (FHIR Coding). FHIR MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction.route.

items.label: Medication Route Code (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The SNOMED CT code for the route of administration. FHIR MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction.route, coded in http://snomed.info/sct.

items.label: Medication (RxNorm)
items.description: The medication ordered. A coded value: the RxNorm code, its display text and the fixed code system, resolved on the code system IRI (FHIR Coding). FHIR MedicationRequest.medicationCodeableConcept.

items.label: Code System: RxNorm
items.description: The code system of a coded value, fixed: RxNorm (http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm). FHIR Coding.system.

items.label: Medication Code (RxNorm)
items.description: The RxNorm code for the medication ordered. FHIR MedicationRequest.medicationCodeableConcept, coded in http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm.

items.label: Patient
items.description: A patient: the Default person demographics by slot (name, birth date, administrative gender, language, country), the medical record number, marital status, death and multiple-birth facts, address, contact point, and references to the general practitioner and managing organization.

items.label: Deceased Indicator
items.description: Whether the patient is deceased. FHIR Patient.deceasedBoolean.

items.label: Language Preferred
items.description: Whether the language is the patient's preferred one. FHIR Patient.communication.preferred.

items.label: Multiple Birth Indicator
items.description: Whether the patient is part of a multiple birth. FHIR Patient.multipleBirthBoolean.

items.label: General Practitioner Reference
items.description: The patient's nominated primary care provider. Holds the IRI of the referenced resource. FHIR Patient.generalPractitioner.

items.label: Managing Organization Reference
items.description: The organization that is the custodian of the patient record. Holds the IRI of the referenced resource. FHIR Patient.managingOrganization.

items.label: Medical Record Number
items.description: The medical record number identifying the patient in the system of record (HL7 v2 identifier type MR). FHIR Patient.identifier.

items.label: Marital Status
items.description: The marital or civil status of a person, using the HL7 v3 MaritalStatus code system.

items.label: Multiple Birth Order
items.description: The patient's order in a multiple birth. FHIR Patient.multipleBirthInteger.

items.label: Deceased Date
items.description: The date and time of death. FHIR Patient.deceasedDateTime.

items.label: Contact Point
items.description: Ways to reach a person or organization: phone, fax, email, website, and the method and use of the contact.

items.label: Website URL
items.description: The URL of a web page or online resource, such as an organization's website or a person's profile page.

items.label: Email Address
items.description: An email address. The pattern requires a local part, an at sign and a domain with a dot; RFC 5321 limits the whole address to 254 characters.

items.label: Fax Number
items.description: A facsimile telephone number, optionally starting with a plus sign and country code, with digits, spaces, hyphens and parentheses allowed.

items.label: Phone Number
items.description: A telephone number, optionally starting with a plus sign and country code, with digits, spaces, hyphens and parentheses allowed.

items.label: Contact Method
items.description: The communication channel of a contact point.

items.label: Contact Use
items.description: The purpose of a contact point.

items.label: International Address
items.description: A mailing address in any country: street lines, city, region, postal code, country and use.

items.label: Address (Line 1)
items.description: The first line of a street address: street number and name, or a post office box.

items.label: Address (Line 2)
items.description: The second line of a street address: apartment, suite, unit, building or floor, when the first line does not carry it.

items.label: City Name
items.description: The name of the city, town or village in an address.

items.label: Postal Code
items.description: The postal code of an address in any country, with no format constraint. Use US ZIP Code or Canada Postal Code where the format is known.

items.label: Region Name
items.description: The name of the state, province or other administrative region in an address, written out rather than coded.

items.label: Address Use
items.description: The purpose of an address.

items.label: Country Code ISO 3166
items.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of a country or territory: the complete list of 249 officially assigned codes. Each value is defined by its Wikidata entity.

items.label: Person (Demographics)
items.description: The demographic core of a person record: name, date of birth, administrative gender, language and country.

items.label: Administrative Gender
items.description: The gender a person is recorded as for administrative purposes. Not clinical or biological sex; see Sex (Recorded).

items.label: Language Code
items.description: The ISO 639-1 two-letter code of a language: the complete list of 184 codes, which are also the BCP 47 primary language subtags. Each value is defined by its Wikidata entity.

items.label: Date of Birth
items.description: The date a person was born.

items.label: Full Name (Person)
items.description: The parts of a person's name and how the name is used.

items.label: Given Name (Person)
items.description: The name given to a person at birth or naming, distinguishing them from others in the same family. Also called first name or forename.

items.label: Middle Name (Person)
items.description: An additional given name, placed between the first given name and the surname.

items.label: Name Prefix
items.description: An honorific or title placed before a person's name, such as Mr., Ms., Dr. or Prof.

items.label: Name Suffix
items.description: A suffix placed after a person's name, such as Jr., Sr., III, PhD, MD or Esq.

items.label: Surname (Person)
items.description: The family name of a person, shared with other members of the family. Also called last name or family name.

items.label: Name Use
items.description: The purpose or context of a person's name.

items.label: Vital Signs Panel
items.description: The vital signs of one measurement session: height, weight, temperature, heart and respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, BMI and blood pressure.

items.label: Observation Status
items.description: The status of the observation result. FHIR Observation.status; ObservationStatus, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Body Height
items.description: Body Height (LOINC 8302-2), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Body Mass Index
items.description: Body mass index (LOINC 39156-5) in kg/m2. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Body Temperature
items.description: Body Temperature (LOINC 8310-5), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Body Weight
items.description: Body Weight (LOINC 29463-7), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Heart Rate
items.description: Heart Rate (LOINC 8867-4), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Oxygen Saturation
items.description: Oxygen Saturation (LOINC 2708-6), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Respiratory Rate
items.description: Respiratory Rate (LOINC 9279-1), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Observation Date Time
items.description: The clinically relevant time of the observation. FHIR Observation.effectiveDateTime.

items.label: Blood Pressure
items.description: A blood pressure reading: systolic and diastolic, body site, status and time.

items.label: Diastolic Blood Pressure
items.description: Diastolic Blood Pressure (LOINC 8462-4), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Systolic Blood Pressure
items.description: Systolic Blood Pressure (LOINC 8480-6), in the Default units by slot. FHIR Observation.valueQuantity.

items.label: Body Site (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The body site the observation was made on. A coded value: the SNOMED CT code, its display text and the fixed code system, resolved on the code system IRI (FHIR Coding). FHIR Observation.bodySite.

items.label: Body Site Code (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The SNOMED CT code for the body site the observation was made on. FHIR Observation.bodySite, coded in http://snomed.info/sct.

items.label: PROV Activity
items.description: A PROV activity: what it was, when it ran, its status, and the entities, activities, agent and plan it relates to.

items.label: Activity Description
items.description: A description of what the activity does and why.

items.label: Activity Identifier
items.description: The identifier of a PROV activity: a URI or another globally unique identifier.

items.label: Activity Label
items.description: A human-readable label for a PROV activity.

items.label: Activity Location
items.description: Where the activity took place (prov:atLocation), as text.

items.label: Activity Type
items.description: The kind of activity, in the vocabulary of the domain (prov:type).

items.label: Error Message
items.description: The error the activity reported, if it failed.

items.label: Had Plan Reference
items.description: The plan the activity followed (prov:hadPlan). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Used Entity Reference
items.description: An entity the activity used (prov:used). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Associated With Reference
items.description: The agent associated with the activity (prov:wasAssociatedWith). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Ended By Reference
items.description: The entity that ended the activity (prov:wasEndedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Informed By Reference
items.description: An activity that informed this one (prov:wasInformedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Started By Reference
items.description: The entity that started the activity (prov:wasStartedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Activity Status
items.description: The state of an activity, from the Data Privacy Vocabulary activity status concepts.

items.label: Ended At
items.description: When the activity ended (prov:endedAtTime).

items.label: Started At
items.description: When the activity started (prov:startedAtTime).

items.label: PROV Agent
items.description: A PROV agent: a person, organization or software agent, with its identity, contact and delegation.

items.label: Acted On Behalf Of Reference
items.description: The agent on whose behalf this agent acted (prov:actedOnBehalfOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Agent Description
items.description: A description of the agent and its responsibilities.

items.label: Agent Email
items.description: The agent's email address (foaf:mbox).

items.label: Agent Identifier
items.description: The identifier of a PROV agent: a URI or another globally unique identifier.

items.label: Agent Name
items.description: The name of the agent (foaf:name).

items.label: Agent Organization Name
items.description: The organization the agent belongs to or is.

items.label: Software Name
items.description: The name of a software agent.

items.label: Software Version
items.description: The version of a software agent.

items.label: PROV Agent Type
items.description: The kind of PROV agent: person, organization or software agent.
